topicName: CI/CD Pipelines for React Native: Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Bitrise
content:
[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"CI/CD Pipelines for React Native: Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Bitrise"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Automating your React Native build and deployment process is crucial for maintaining a fast, reliable, and error-free release cycle. In this tutorial, we will explore how to set up a robust CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions, Bitrise, and Fastlane."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Prerequisites and Architecture Overview"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Before diving into the configuration files, ensure you have an Apple Developer account, a Google Play Console account, and basic familiarity with React Native CLI projects. Our architecture will use GitHub Actions for version control triggers and linting, and Bitrise for heavy iOS and Android compilation."},{"order":5,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 1: Configuring Fastlane for iOS and Android"},{"order":6,"type":"paragraph","text":"Fastlane automates the tedious parts of app deployment. Navigate to your React Native project directory and initialize Fastlane inside your android and ios folders."},{"order":7,"type":"code","text":"cd ios && fastlane init
cd ../android && fastlane init"},{"order":8,"type":"paragraph","text":"Next, update your ios/fastlane/Fastfile to define a beta deployment lane using TestFlight."},{"order":9,"type":"code","text":"default_platform(:ios)

platform :ios do
  desc "Push a new beta build to TestFlight"
  lane :beta do
    increment_build_number(xcodeproj: "YourApp.xcodeproj")
    build_app(workspace: "YourApp.xcworkspace", scheme: "YourApp")
    upload_to_testflight
  end
end"},{"order":10,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 2: Setting up GitHub Actions for Continuous Integration"},{"order":11,"type":"paragraph","text":"Create a workflow file at .github/workflows/ci.yml to automatically run tests and linters on every pull request."},{"order":12,"type":"code","text":"name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Use Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: 18
          cache: 'yarn'
      - run: yarn install
      - run: yarn lint
      - run: yarn test"},{"order":13,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 3: Integrating Bitrise for CD Deployment"},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"Bitrise provides native Mac machines ideal for compiling Xcode projects. Connect your GitHub repository to Bitrise and configure your bitrise.yml file to execute Fastlane lanes."},{"order":15,"type":"code","text":"format_version: "11"
default_step_lib_source: https://github.com/bitrise-io/bitrise-steplib.git
workflows:
  deploy:
    steps:
    - activate-ssh-key@4.0.3:
        run_if: "{{getenv "SSH_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY"}} != ""
    - git-clone@6.2.8:
    - npm@1.1.1:
        inputs:
        - command: install
    - fastlane@2.19.0:
        inputs:
        - lane: ios beta"},{"order":16,"type":"subheading","text":"Best Practices and Security"},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Never commit your keystores, App Store Connect API keys, or service account JSON files directly to version control."},{"order":18,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use GitHub Secrets and Bitrise Secrets to securely inject environment variables during the build phase."},{"order":19,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Cache node_modules and CocoaPods dependencies to drastically reduce pipeline execution time."},{"order":20,"type":"paragraph","text":"By combining GitHub Actions for code validation and Bitrise with Fastlane for app store distribution, you have created a scalable, enterprise-grade CI/CD pipeline for your React Native application."}]
